Definition: something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture bdellium means bdellium, a fragrant gum, and it shows up twice, in Genesis 2:12 and Numbers 11:7.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bdellium still matters, even appearing only a few times, because God chose it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
